item.title: Browser Setu 0.3.3
item.description: Build 10 of 0.3.3. Passwords now save and fill (including App Store Connect-style sign-in frames, with a Save password card and an iCloud Keychain option); YouTube ads blocked by default; pop-up handling; right-click menus; drag to customize sidebar and address bar buttons; redesigned Bookmarks, History and Downloads panels, start page and Settings; first-run setup; Pure Black theme; smoother lists. See the README and docs/releases/0.3.3-build-10.md.

item.title: Browser Setu 0.3.3
item.description: Downloads now show progress while they run and a Downloaded card when they finish, instead of saving silently.

item.title: Browser Setu 0.3.2
item.description: No videos or sound starting by themselves while you scroll, new-tab suggestions drawn above the page, and split view with exactly equal shares and up to four panels (a 2x2 grid).

item.title: Browser Setu 0.3.1
item.description: Themes reach the whole window, the toolbar takes the page's colour, workspace and split-view buttons in every top-bar layout, drag a tab between windows, tidier workspace settings, and a full feature guide in the README.

item.title: Browser Setu 0.3.0
item.description: Advanced sync (a switch for each kind of thing, history sync, send a tab to another device, clear sync status), ten classic themes plus theme import and export, a Customize panel on the start page, typo-tolerant search across tabs, three-panel split view, certificate summary, guest window, per-site JavaScript and never-sleep list, fingerprint randomizing, De-AMP, YouTube ad skipping, leaked-password check, calculator and unit conversions, PDF editor with signing and redaction, accessibility improvements.

item.title: Browser Setu 0.2.0
item.description: First public release. A native WebKit browser for macOS with a Rust core: tabs, sidebar layouts, workspaces, content blocking, per-site privacy, saved passwords in your Keychain, web extensions, research collections, developer tools, and automatic updates. Early release: see docs/capabilities.md for what has been checked and what has not.
